title.zh: 卷六 本紀第六 成祖二
title.raw: 卷六 本紀第六 成祖二 Volume 6 Annals 6: Chengzu 2

sentences.zh: 永樂元年春正月己卯朔，禦奉天殿受朝賀，宴群臣及屬國使。

translations.literal: In Yongle year 1, spring, first month, on jimao, the first day of the month, he held court at Fengtian Hall to receive court congratulations and feasted the officials and envoys from tributary states.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongle, on the new moon of the first month of spring, the Emperor held court at Fengtian Hall to receive New Year felicitations and gave a banquet for his ministers and envoys from the tributary states.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，享太廟。

translations.literal: On yiyou, enjoyed sacrifice at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On xinmao he performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth in the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 復周王橚、齊王榑、代王桂、岷王楩舊封。

translations.literal: He restored the former enfeoffments of Zhou Prince Su, Qi Prince Fu, Dai Prince Gui, and Min Prince Bian.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou prince Su, the Qi prince Fu, the Dai prince Gui, and the Min prince Bian had their former fiefs restored.

sentences.zh: 以北平為北京。

translations.literal: He made Beiping the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Beiping was designated the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，何定侯孟善鎮遼東。

translations.literal: On guisi Hedeng Marquis Meng Shan was stationed to guard Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Marquis Meng Shan of Hedeng was posted to guard Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宋晟為平羌將軍，鎮甘肅。

translations.literal: On dingyou Song Sheng was made General Who Pacifies the Qiang and stationed in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Song Sheng was named General Who Pacifies the Qiang and garrisoned in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，設北京留守行後軍都督府、行部、國子監，改北平曰順天府。

translations.literal: Second month, gengxu: he established the Beijing rear-garrison office of the Rear Army Regional Military Commission, the touring ministry, and the National University, and changed Beiping to Shuntian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengxu, he set up the Beijing rear-garrison command, a touring secretariat, and a branch of the National University, and renamed Beiping Shuntian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣御史分巡天下，為定制。

translations.literal: On yimao he dispatched censors to tour the realm in separate missions, making it a standing regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao censors were sent on circuit throughout the empire, a practice thereafter made permanent.

sentences.zh: 己未，徙封寧王權於南昌。

translations.literal: On jiwei he transferred the enfeoffment of Ning Prince Quan to Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Prince Quan of Ning was moved to a new fief at Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 貽書鬼力赤可汗，許其遣使通好。

translations.literal: He sent a letter to Khan Güilichi, permitting him to send envoys to open friendly relations.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote to Khan Güilichi, agreeing that the latter might send envoys to establish friendly ties.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On guihai he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，遣使徵尚師哈立麻於烏斯藏。

translations.literal: On yichou he dispatched envoys to summon Shangshi Halima from U-Tsang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou envoys were sent to summon the preceptor Halima from Tibet.

sentences.zh: 己巳，振北京六府饑。

translations.literal: On jisi he provided relief for famine in the six prefectures of Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi relief was extended to famine victims in Beijing's six prefectures.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命法司五日一引奏罪囚。

translations.literal: On xinwei he ordered the legal offices to present criminal prisoners for judgment once every five days.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the judiciary was ordered to bring prisoners before the throne for review every five days.

sentences.zh: 壬申，瘞戰地暴骨。

translations.literal: On renshen he buried the exposed bones on battlefields.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the unburied dead on battlefields were interred.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，高陽王高煦備邊開平。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Prince of Gaoyang Gaoxu prepared the border at Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Prince of Gaoyang, Zhu Gaoxu, took charge of frontier defense at Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，江陰侯吳高鎮大同。

translations.literal: Third month, gengchen: Marquis of Jiangyin Wu Gao was stationed at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengchen, the Marquis of Jiangyin, Wu Gao, was posted to Datong.

sentences.zh: 壬午，改北平行都司為大寧都司，徙保定，始以大寧地畀兀良哈。

translations.literal: On renwu he changed the Beiping Regional Military Commission to the Daning Regional Military Commission, moved it to Baoding, and for the first time ceded Daning territory to the Uriyangqad.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Beiping regional command was reorganized as the Daning command and relocated to Baoding; Daning lands were for the first time granted to the Uriyangqad.

sentences.zh: 戊子，平江伯陳瑄、都督僉事宣信充總兵官，督海運，餉遼東、北京，歲以為常。

translations.literal: On wuzi Earl of Pingjiang Chen Xuan and Assistant Commander Xuan Xin were made commander-in-chief, supervising sea transport to supply Liaodong and Beijing, yearly made constant.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Earl of Pingjiang, Chen Xuan, and Assistant Commander Xuan Xin were appointed joint commanders-in-chief to oversee grain shipments by sea to Liaodong and Beijing, thereafter an annual routine.

sentences.zh: 甲午，振直隸、北京、山東、河南饑。

translations.literal: On jiawu he provided relief for famine in Zhili, Beijing, Shandong, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu famine relief was sent to Zhili, Beijing, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未朔，安南胡氣襲陳氏封爵，遣使察實以聞。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, dingwei, new moon: Hu Di in Annam presumptuously seized the Chen family's titles and ranks; envoys were dispatched to investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, at the new moon on dingwei, word came that Hu Di in Annam had usurped the Chen house's enfeoffment; envoys were sent to verify the facts.

sentences.zh: 己酉，戶部尚書夏原吉治蘇、松、嘉、湖水患。

translations.literal: On jiyou Minister of Revenue Xia Yuanji remedied flood disasters in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Lake Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the minister of revenue Xia Yuanji was put in charge of flood control on the Suzhou–Songjiang–Jiaxing–Taihu circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛未，岷王楩有罪，降其官屬。

translations.literal: On xinwei Min Prince Bian was guilty; his official staff were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Prince Bian of Min was found guilty and his household officers were reduced in rank.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，襄城伯李濬鎮江西。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Earl of Xiangcheng Li Jun was stationed in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Earl of Xiangcheng, Li Jun, was posted to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，除天下荒田未墾者額稅。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingchou: abolished quota taxes on unworked wasteland throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingchou, grain quotas were lifted on uncultivated wasteland empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 癸未，宥死罪以下，遞減一等。

translations.literal: On guiwei he pardoned those below the death penalty, each reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei criminals below capital punishment were pardoned, each sentence reduced by one degree.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，捕山東蝗。

translations.literal: On gengyin he captured locusts in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin locusts were hunted in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，河南蝗，免今年夏稅。

translations.literal: On dingyou Henan had locusts; this year's summer tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou a locust plague struck Henan and the summer levy was waived for the year.

sentences.zh: 是月，再論靖難功，封駙馬都尉袁容等三人為侯。

translations.literal: That month, rewards for pacifying the difficulty were reassessed; the Emperor's son-in-law Yuan Rong and two others were enfeoffed as marquises.
translations.idiomatic: That month service in the Pacification was rewarded again: the emperor's son-in-law Yuan Rong and two others were made marquises.

sentences.zh: 陳亨子懋等六人為伯。

translations.literal: Chen Heng's son Mao and five others were made earls.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Heng's son Mao and five others were enfeoffed as earls.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，代王桂有罪，削其護衛。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renzi: Dai Prince Gui was guilty; his guard corps was stripped away.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi, Prince Gui of Dai was punished and his princely guard was cut.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遣給事中、御史分行天下，撫安軍民，有司好貪者逮治。

translations.literal: On guichou he dispatched supervising secretaries and censors in separate missions throughout the realm to comfort armies and people; greedy officials were seized and punished.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou supervising secretaries and censors fanned out across the empire to reassure troops and civilians; venal officials were arrested.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，改上高皇帝、高皇后尊謚。

translations.literal: On dingsi he changed the honorific posthumous titles of the High Emperor and High Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the posthumous honorifics of Taizu and the founding empress were revised.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，武安侯鄭亨鎮宣府。

translations.literal: On wuchen Wu'an Marquis Zheng Heng was stationed at Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the Marquis of Wu'an, Zheng Heng, was posted to Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅，復貽書鬼力赤。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengyin: he again sent a letter to Güilichi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengyin, he wrote again to Khan Güilichi.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，發流罪以下墾北京田。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jisi: those sentenced to exile or below were sent to open fields in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi, convicts below exile grade were sent to till land around Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，徙直隸蘇州等十郡、浙江等九省富民實北京。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he moved wealthy households from ten prefectures of Zhili including Suzhou and nine provinces of Zhejiang to fill Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu prosperous families from ten Zhili prefectures including Suzhou and from nine Zhejiang circuits were relocated to populate Beijing.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，命寶源局鑄農器，給山東被兵窮民。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guiwei: ordered the Bureau of the Treasury Source to cast farm tools and give them to the destitute people of Shandong harmed by warfare.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiwei, the Bureau of the Treasury Source was ordered to cast farming tools for Shandong's war-ruined poor.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，初遣中官馬彬使爪哇諸國。

translations.literal: On gengyin for the first time the eunuch Ma Bin was sent as envoy to the countries of Java.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the eunuch Ma Bin was for the first time dispatched on embassy to Java and neighboring states.

sentences.zh: 乙未，奪歷城侯盛庸爵，尋自殺。

translations.literal: On yiwei the title of Licheng Marquis Sheng Yong was stripped; soon he killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the Marquis of Licheng, Sheng Yong, was deprived of his rank; he took his own life soon after.

sentences.zh: 庚子，岷王楩有罪，削其護衛。

translations.literal: On gengzi Min Prince Bian was guilty; his guard corps was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Prince Bian of Min was again found guilty and his guard was cut.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙亥朔，頒歷於朝鮮諸國，著為令。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, yihai, new moon: the calendar was issued to Korea and other states, established as an ordinance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, at the new moon on yihai, the court calendar was distributed to Korea and other tributaries as a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，罷遣浚河民夫。

translations.literal: On renchen he dismissed and sent home the laborers dredging rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the corvée gangs working on river dredging were released.

sentences.zh: 甲午，北京地震。

translations.literal: On jiawu Beijing earthquaked.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an earthquake struck Beijing.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命六科辦事官言事。

translations.literal: On yiwei he ordered the six supervising secretaries on duty to memorialize on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the six supervising secretaries on rotation were instructed to submit memorials.

sentences.zh: 丙申，韓觀討柳州山賊，平之。

translations.literal: On bingshen Han Guan campaigned against mountain bandits in Liuzhou and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Han Guan suppressed the mountain bandits of Liuzhou and pacified the region.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁卯，封胡為安南國王。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, dingmao: Hu was enfeoffed as King of Annam.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingmao, Hu was invested as king of Annam.

sentences.zh: 是年，始命內臣出鎮及監京營軍。

translations.literal: That year, for the first time eunuchs were ordered out to command garrisons and to supervise the capital army camps.
translations.idiomatic: That year eunuchs were for the first time sent to command regional garrisons and to supervise the capital camps.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢者六，自是歲時貢賀為常。

translations.literal: Korea came to tribute six times; from this year seasonal tribute and congratulations became constant.
translations.idiomatic: Korea presented tribute six times; thereafter seasonal offerings and New Year felicitations became routine.

sentences.zh: 琉球中山、山北、山南，暹羅，占城，爪哇西王，日本，剌泥，安南入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu Chuzan, Shoboku, and Nanzan, Siam, Champa, the western king of Java, Japan, Lani, and Annam came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys came from Chuzan, northern Ryukyu, southern Ryukyu, Siam, Champa, the western king of Java, Japan, Lani, and Annam.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring, first month, yimao: great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongle, in the first month of spring, on yimao, he performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth in the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 己巳，召世子高熾及高陽王高煦還京師。

translations.literal: On jisi he summoned the heir Zhu Gaochi and Prince of Gaoyang Gaoxu back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the heir apparent Zhu Gaochi and the Prince of Gaoyang, Zhu Gaoxu, were recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，賜曾棨等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, yisi: awarded palace graduates including Zeng Qi with first rank, regular rank, and origin in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yisi, the new jinshi including Zeng Qi were graded into top, middle, and lower classes.

sentences.zh: 己酉，始選進士為翰林院庶吉士。

translations.literal: On jiyou for the first time palace graduates were selected as Hanlin bachelor trainees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou graduates of the metropolitan examination were for the first time chosen as Hanlin probationers.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，吏部請罪千戶違制薦士者，帝曰：“馬周不因常何進乎？

translations.literal: On gengxu the Ministry of Personnel asked to punish a commander of a thousand who had violated regulations by recommending a scholar; the Emperor said: 「Did not Ma Zhou enter through Chang He's recommendation?
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Ministry of Personnel sought punishment for a chiliarch who had breached rules by sponsoring a candidate. The Emperor said, 「Did not Ma Zhou gain office through Chang He's introduction?

sentences.zh: 果才，授之官，否則罷之可耳。

translations.literal: If he truly has talent, give him office; if not, dismiss him — that is all.
translations.idiomatic: If the man has talent, appoint him; if not, send him away. Nothing more is needed.

sentences.zh: ”戊辰，改封敷惠王允熙甌寧王，奉懿文太子祀。

translations.literal: 」On wuchen he changed the enfeoffment of Fu Hui Prince Yunxi to Ouning Prince, to maintain the sacrifices for the Yiwen crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: 」On wuchen the Fu Hui prince Zhu Yunxi was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Ouning, charged with maintaining the cult of the Yiwen crown prince.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未朔，置東宮官屬。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinwei, new moon: established Eastern Palace officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, at the new moon on xinwei, officers for the heir apparent's establishment were appointed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，僧道衍為太子少師，復共姓姚，賜名廣孝。

translations.literal: On renshen the monk Daoyan was made Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince, restored the surname Yao, and was granted the name Guangxiao.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the monk Daoyan became junior tutor to the crown prince, resumed the clan name Yao, and received the honor name Guangxiao.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，立子高熾為皇太子，封高煦漢王，高燧趙王。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he installed son Gaochi as crown prince; enfeoffed Gaoxu as Prince of Han and Gaochui as Prince of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Zhu Gaochi was made crown prince; Zhu Gaoxu was enfeoffed as Prince of Han and Zhu Gaochui as Prince of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 壬午，封汪應祖為琉球國山南王。

translations.literal: On renwu Wang Yingzu was enfeoffed as King of Nanzan in Ryukyu.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Wang Yingzu was invested as king of southern Ryukyu.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，豐城侯李彬鎮廣東，清遠伯王友充總兵官，率舟師巡海。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renyin: Fengcheng Marquis Li Bin was stationed in Guangdong; Qingyuan Earl Wang You was made commander-in-chief, leading a naval force to patrol the seas.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renyin, the Marquis of Fengcheng guarded Guangdong while the Earl of Qingyuan, Wang You, took command of the fleet on coastal patrol.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，汰冗官。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dinghai: eliminated supernumerary officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dinghai, redundant posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，振松江、嘉興、蘇州、湖州饑。

translations.literal: On xinmao he provided relief for famine in Songjiang, Jiaxing, Suzhou, and Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao famine relief went to Songjiang, Jiaxing, Suzhou, and Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，封哈密安克帖木兒為忠順王。

translations.literal: On jiawu he enfeoffed Aqq Tagh Timür of Hami as Prince Who is Loyal and Obedient.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Aqq Tagh Timür of Hami was invested as the Loyal and Obedient prince.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，鄱陽民進書毀先賢，杖之，毀其書。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renxu: a Poyang commoner presented a book slandering the former sages; he was beaten with the rod and the book destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renxu, a man of Poyang submitted a work defaming the sages; he was flogged and the book burned.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，振江西、湖廣水災。

translations.literal: On bingyin he provided relief for flood disasters in Jiangxi and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin flood victims in Jiangxi and Huguang received relief.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，故安南國王陳日煃弟天平來奔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingyou: Chen Tianping, younger brother of the former King of Annam Chen Rizhao, came in flight.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou, Chen Tianping, brother of the former Annamese king Chen Rizhao, fled to the court.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，周王橚來朝，獻騶虞，百官請賀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingwu: Zhou Prince Su came to court, presented a zouyu, and the hundred officials asked to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingwu, Prince Su of Zhou attended court with a zouyu; the bureaucracy urged celebration.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：“瑞應依德而至，騶虞若果為祥，在朕更當修省。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: 「Auspicious responses arrive according to virtue; if the zouyu is truly a blessing, I ought all the more to examine myself.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, 「Portents follow virtue. If this zouyu is truly a blessing, I must examine myself all the more.

sentences.zh: ”丁卯，徙山西民萬戶實北京。

translations.literal: 」On dingmao ten thousand households of Shanxi were moved to fill Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: 」On dingmao ten thousand households from Shanxi were relocated to bolster Beijing.

sentences.zh: 命自今御史巡行察吏毋得摭拾人言，賢否皆具實跡以聞。

translations.literal: He ordered that from now when censors toured and inspected officials they must not gather gossip; whether worthy or not, all were to report with verified facts.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth touring censors were forbidden to rely on rumor; every report on an official's character was to rest on verified fact.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，河決開封。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dingchou: the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingchou, the Yellow River broke through at Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，蒲城、河津黃河清。

translations.literal: On yiyou, at Pucheng and Hejin the Yellow River ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Yellow River ran clear at Pucheng and Hejin.

sentences.zh: 是月，籍長興侯耿炳文家，炳文自殺。

translations.literal: That month, the household of Changxing Marquis Geng Bingwen was inventoried; Bingwen killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: That month the estate of the Marquis of Changxing, Geng Bingwen, was confiscated; he took his own life.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，禦奉天門錄囚。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiachen: he held court at Fengtian Gate to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, the Emperor held court at Fengtian Gate to review criminal cases.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，京師及濟南、開封地震，敕群臣修省。

translations.literal: On guichou the capital and Jinan and Kaifeng earthquaked; he charged the ministers to examine themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou earthquakes struck the capital, Jinan, and Kaifeng; the court was ordered to moral self-scrutiny.

sentences.zh: 戊午，蠲蘇、松、嘉、湖、杭水災田租。

translations.literal: On wuwu he remitted field rents in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, the lake country, and Hangzhou for flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu land tax was waived for flood-stricken districts on the Suzhou–Songjiang–Jiaxing–Taihu–Hangzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，同州、韓城黃河清。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renchen: the Yellow River ran clear at Tongzhou and Hancheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renchen, the Yellow River ran clear at Tongzhou and Hancheng.

sentences.zh: 是月，下李景隆於獄。

translations.literal: That month, Li Jinglong was committed to prison.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Jinglong was imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城，別失八里，琉球山北、山南，爪哇，真臘入貢。

translations.literal: That year Champa, Beshbaligh, Ryukyu Shoboku and Nanzan, Java, and Zhenla came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys came from Champa, Beshbaligh, northern and southern Ryukyu, Java, and Zhenla.

sentences.zh: 暹羅，日本，琉球中山入貢者再。

translations.literal: Siam, Japan, and Ryukyu Chuzan came to tribute twice.
translations.idiomatic: Siam, Japan, and Chuzan each sent tribute twice.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring, first month, gengxu: great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongle, in the first month of spring, on gengxu, he performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth in the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣使責諭安南。

translations.literal: On jiayin envoys were dispatched to rebuke and instruct Annam.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin envoys were sent to reprimand Annam.

sentences.zh: 庚申，復免順天、永平、保定田租二年。

translations.literal: On gengshen field rents in Shuntian, Yongping, and Baoding were again remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen land tax in Shuntian, Yongping, and Baoding was waived for another two years.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，行部尚書雒僉以言事涉怨誹誅。

translations.literal: Second month, jisi: touring ministry minister Luo Qian was executed for memorializing in a way that touched on resentment and slander.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jisi, the touring minister Luo Qian was executed after memorializing in language judged slanderous.

sentences.zh: 癸未，趙王高燧居守北京。

translations.literal: On guiwei Zhao Prince Gaochui was left to guard Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the Prince of Zhao, Zhu Gaochui, was left to hold Beijing.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，免湖廣被水田租。

translations.literal: Third month, jiayin: field rents were remitted in Huguang for flooded fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiayin, land tax was waived on inundated fields in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 夏六月己卯，中官鄭和帥舟師使西洋諸國。

translations.literal: Summer, sixth month, jimao: eunuch Zheng He commanded a fleet to envoy the countries of the Western Ocean.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on jimao, the eunuch Zheng He led the fleet on the first voyage to the Western Ocean states.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，中官山壽等帥兵出雲州覘敵。

translations.literal: On gengchen eunuchs Shan Shou and others commanded troops out of Yunzhou to reconnoiter the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the eunuch Shan Shou and others led troops from Yunzhou to scout the enemy.

sentences.zh: 甲申，夏原吉等振蘇、松、嘉、湖饑。

translations.literal: On jiashen Xia Yuanji and others provided relief for famine in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and the lake country.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Xia Yuanji and his colleagues relieved famine on the Suzhou–Songjiang–Jiaxing–Taihu circuit.

sentences.zh: 免天下農民戶口食鹽鈔。

translations.literal: The salt-tax coupons for farming households throughout the realm were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Salt-tax coupons for farming households were abolished empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，胡謝罪，請迎陳天平歸國。

translations.literal: On gengyin Hu apologized for his crimes and asked to welcome Chen Tianping back to his state.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Hu submitted a confession and asked permission to escort Chen Tianping home.

sentences.zh: 秋九月丁酉，蠲蘇、松、嘉、湖水災田租，凡三百三十八萬石。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month, dingyou: field rents were remitted for flood disaster in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and the lake country, in all 3.38 million piculs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on dingyou, flood-land tax was waived on the Jiangnan lake circuit for a total of 3,380,000 piculs.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，徙山西民萬戶實北京。

translations.literal: On dingsi ten thousand households of Shanxi were moved to fill Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi another ten thousand Shanxi households were relocated to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，盜殺駙馬都尉梅殷。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: bandits killed the emperor's son-in-law Mei Yin.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the emperor's son-in-law Mei Yin was murdered by bandits.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，齊王榑有罪，三賜書戒之。

translations.literal: On dingmao Qi Prince Fu was guilty; three times imperial letters of admonition were sent.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Prince Fu of Qi was judged guilty and received three imperial letters of warning.

sentences.zh: 戊子，頒《祖訓》於諸王。

translations.literal: On wuzi he promulgated the Ancestral Instructions among the princes.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Ancestral Instructions were issued to all princely houses.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，沐晟討八百，降之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuchen: Mu Sheng campaigned against the eight hundred states and received their surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, Mu Sheng campaigned against the Moeng Baung kingdom and brought it to submission.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，都督僉事黃中、呂毅以兵納陳天平於安南。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Regional Commander Huang Zhong and Lü Yi led troops to escort Chen Tianping into Annam.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the regional commanders Huang Zhong and Lü Yi marched Chen Tianping into Annam under arms.

sentences.zh: 是年，蘇門答剌、滿剌加、古裏、浡泥來貢，封其長為王。

translations.literal: That year Samudera, Malacca, Calicut, and Brunei came to offer tribute; their chiefs were enfeoffed as kings.
translations.idiomatic: In that year envoys came from Samudera, Malacca, Calicut, and Brunei, and their rulers were invested as kings.

sentences.zh: 日本貢馬，並俘獲倭寇為邊患者。

translations.literal: Japan presented horses and also captives taken from Japanese pirates who had troubled the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Japan sent horses and handed over wokou seized on the coast who had harried the borders.

sentences.zh: 爪哇東、西，占城，碟裏，日羅夏治，合貓裏，火州回回入貢。

translations.literal: East and West Java, Champa, Dieli, Narai Xiazhi, Hemali, and the Muslim communities of Huozhou presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute arrived from eastern and western Java, Champa, Dieli, Narai Xiazhi, Hemali, and the Huozhou Muslims.

sentences.zh: 暹羅，琉球山南、山北入貢者再，琉球中山入貢者三。

translations.literal: Siam came to offer tribute; Ryukyu's southern and northern kings did so twice, and Ryukyu's central king three times.
translations.idiomatic: Siam sent tribute; the southern and northern kings of Ryukyu came twice, the central king thrice.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丁未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the fourth year, on the day dingwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, first month of spring, on dingwei, the emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，初禦午朝，令群臣奏事得從容陳論。

translations.literal: On bingchen, for the first time he held court at the midday audience, ordering the ministers to present business and speak their views at leisure.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he inaugurated the noon audience, bidding ministers lay business before him and debate without haste.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯朔，釋奠於先師孔子。

translations.literal: On the first day xinmao of the third month, the sacrifice to the First Teacher Confucius was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the new moon of the third month, he performed the Confucian sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 甲午，設遼東開原、廣寧馬市。

translations.literal: On jiawu, horse markets were established at Kaiyuan and Guangning in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu horse markets were opened at Kaiyuan and Guangning in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賜林環等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On yisi, Lin Huan and other metropolitan graduates were granted the jinshi with ranks of Presented Scholar and Regular Graduate according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Lin Huan and the new jinshi were graduated into the Presented Scholar and Regular Graduate ranks as their marks allowed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，胡襲殺陳天平於芹站，前大理卿薛巖死之，黃中等引兵還。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Hu Qi ambushed and killed Chen Tianping at Qinzhan; the former Minister of Justice Xue Yan died; Huang Zhong and the others led the army back.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Hu Qi struck down Chen Tianping at Qinzhan; Xue Yan, lately minister of justice, was killed, and Huang Zhong withdrew his column.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，遣使購遺書。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jimao, envoys were sent to purchase lost books.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jimao, the court commissioned envoys to buy up lost books.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，振常州、廬州、安慶饑。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingyou, relief was extended to the famine in Changzhou, Luzhou, and Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingyou, grain relief was sent to famine districts in Changzhou, Luzhou, and Anqing.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，齊王榑有罪，削官屬護衛，留之京師。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the Prince of Qi, Fu, was guilty of an offense; his household officials and guards were reduced, and he was detained in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Prince Fu of Qi was judged guilty; his staff and guards were stripped away and he was kept in the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月己未朔，日當食，陰雲不見，禮官請表賀，不許。

translations.literal: On the first day jiwei of the sixth month, the sun was due to be eclipsed, but clouds hid it; the ritual officials requested a congratulatory memorial, and this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the new moon of the sixth month, an eclipse was due but clouds veiled the sky; the Board of Rites asked to felicitate the throne, and the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，南陽獻瑞麥，諭禮部曰：“比郡縣屢奏祥瑞，獨比為豐年之兆。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Nanyang presented auspicious wheat; he instructed the Board of Rites, saying: "Of late the prefectures and counties have repeatedly reported felicitous omens, but this alone is a sign of an abundant year."
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Nanyang offered miracle wheat; he told the Board of Rites, "Districts keep reporting lucky signs, yet only this betokens a full harvest."

sentences.zh: ”命薦之宗廟。

translations.literal: He ordered that it be presented at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded that it be offered at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，硃能為征夷將軍，沐晟、張輔副之，帥師分道討安南，兵部尚書劉俊參贊軍務，行部尚書黃福、大理卿陳洽督餉。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinmao, Zhu Neng was made General for the Punitive Campaign against the Barbarians, with Mu Sheng and Zhang Fu as his deputies; they led armies by separate routes to attack Annam; the Minister of War Liu Jun assisted in military affairs; the Acting Minister Huang Fu and the Minister of Justice Chen Qia supervised supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinmao, Zhu Neng was appointed general for the punitive expedition against Annam, with Mu Sheng and Zhang Fu as lieutenants; they marched by several routes while Liu Jun of the Ministry of War advised on operations and Huang Fu and Chen Qia directed the commissariat.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：“安南皆朕赤子，惟黎季犛父子首惡必誅，他脅從者釋之。

translations.literal: An edict said: "All in Annam are Our children; only the father and son Lê Qui Lý are chief villains who must be put to death; the rest who were coerced shall be released."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Every soul in Annam is Our child; only Lê Qui Lý and his son are ringleaders who must die—the coerced shall go free."

sentences.zh: 罪人既得，立陳氏子孫賢者。

translations.literal: "When the guilty are taken, set up a worthy man of the Chen clan.
translations.idiomatic: Once the guilty are seized, enthrone a worthy scion of the Chen house.

sentences.zh: 毋養亂，毋玩寇，毋毀廬墓，毋害禾稼，毋攘財貨掠子女，毋殺降。

translations.literal: "Do not nourish disorder, do not treat the enemy lightly, do not destroy houses and tombs, do not harm the standing grain, do not seize goods or carry off women and children, do not kill those who surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Do not feed rebellion, do not toy with the foe, do not raze dwellings and graves, do not trample the crops, do not plunder goods or abduct women, do not slay those who yield.

sentences.zh: 有一於此，雖功不宥。

translations.literal: "If there is one of these, merit shall not win pardon."
translations.idiomatic: Whoever commits any of these, though his service be great, shall not be spared.

sentences.zh: ”乙巳，申誹謗之禁。

translations.literal: On yisi, the prohibition on slander was reaffirmed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the ban on slanderous speech was proclaimed anew.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬戌，詔以明年五月建北京宮殿，分遣大臣采木於四川、湖廣、江西、浙江、山西。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on renxu, an edict ordered that in the fifth month of the coming year the Beijing palaces should be built, and great ministers were dispatched to gather timber in Sichuan, Huguang, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, and Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renxu, an edict fixed the coming fifth month for raising the Beijing palaces and sent grand ministers to levy timber in Sichuan, Huguang, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，詔通政司，凡上書奏民事者，雖小必以聞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingyou, an edict to the Office of Transmission ordered that whenever memorials on the people's affairs were submitted, however small the matter, it must be reported.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou, the Office of Transmission was commanded to relay every civilian petition, however slight.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，齊王榑廢為庶人。

translations.literal: On guichou, the Prince of Qi, Fu, was degraded to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Prince Fu of Qi was reduced to commoner rank.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，振蘇、松、常、杭、嘉、湖流民復業者十二萬余戶。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuchen, more than 120,000 households of drifting people in Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou who returned to their occupations were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuchen, relief was granted to over 120,000 households of vagrants in the Lake Tai region who had resumed farming.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，成國公硃能卒於軍，張輔代領其眾。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuzi, the Duke of Cheng, Zhu Neng, died in the army; Zhang Fu took command of his forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuzi, Zhu Neng, Duke of Cheng, died on campaign; Zhang Fu assumed his command.

sentences.zh: 乙未，克隘留關。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Ailiao Pass was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the army stormed Ailiao Pass.

sentences.zh: 庚子，沐晟率師會於白鶴。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Mu Sheng led his army to join the main force at White Crane.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Mu Sheng's column united with the main army at White Crane.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，甘露降孝陵松柏，醴泉出神樂觀，薦之太廟，賜百官。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jisi, sweet dew fell on the pines and cypresses of the Xiaoling Mausoleum, and a spring of sweet wine appeared at the Divine Music Office; these were presented at the Grand Temple and bestowed on the officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jisi, sweet dew descended on the Xiaoling pines and a spring of sweet wine welled at the Divine Music Office; both were offered at the Grand Temple and shared with the bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，赦天下殊死以下。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinmao, a general amnesty was granted for crimes below capital punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinmao, the throne pardoned all crimes short of death.

sentences.zh: 張輔大破安南兵於嘉林江。

translations.literal: Zhang Fu inflicted a great defeat on the Annam army at the Jialin River.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fu shattered the Annamese host on the Jialin River.

sentences.zh: 丙申，拔多邦城。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Duobang city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Duobang fell.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，克其東都。

translations.literal: On dingyou, their eastern capital was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the eastern capital was seized.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，克西都，賊遁入海。

translations.literal: On guimao, the western capital was taken, and the rebels fled to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the western capital fell and the rebels took to the sea.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，甌寧王允熙邸第火，王薨。

translations.literal: On xinhai, fire broke out at the residence of Yunxi, Prince of Ouning, and the prince died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai fire consumed the mansion of Yunxi, Prince of Ouning, and the prince perished in it.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅，占城，於闐，浡泥，日本，琉球中山、山南、婆羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year Siam, Champa, Khotan, Brunei, Japan, Ryukyu's central and southern kings, and Borneo presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In that year tribute came from Siam, Champa, Khotan, Brunei, Japan, the central and southern kings of Ryukyu, and Borneo.

sentences.zh: 爪哇東、西，真臘入貢者再。

translations.literal: East and West Java and Zhenla presented tribute twice.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern and western Java and Zhenla sent envoys twice.

sentences.zh: 別失八里入貢者三。

translations.literal: Beshbalik presented tribute three times.
translations.idiomatic: Beshbalik dispatched tribute missions thrice.

sentences.zh: 琉球進閹人，還之，回回結牙曲進玉碗，卻之。

translations.literal: Ryukyu presented eunuchs; they were sent back; Jieyaqu of the Muslims presented a jade bowl; it was declined.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu offered eunuchs, who were returned; Jieyaqu of the Muslim lands sent a jade bowl, which the court refused.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丁卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the fifth year, on the day dingmao, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, first month of spring, on dingmao, the emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 己巳，張輔大敗安南兵於木丸江。

translations.literal: On jisi, Zhang Fu inflicted a great defeat on the Annam army at the Muwan River.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zhang Fu broke the Annamese army on the Muwan River.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，出翰林學士解縉為廣西參議。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengyin, the Hanlin Academician Xie Jin was sent out as Administrative Commissioner of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengyin, Xie Jin of the Hanlin Academy was posted to Guangxi as administrative commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，封尚師哈立麻為大實法王。

translations.literal: In the third month, on dingsi, the Preceptor Halima was enfeoffed as Great Precious Dharma King.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingsi, the Tibetan preceptor Halima was invested as Great Precious Dharma King.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，張輔大破安南兵於富良江。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Zhang Fu inflicted a great defeat on the Annam army at the Fuliang River.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Zhang Fu routed the Annamese on the Fuliang River.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，振順天、河間、保定饑。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou, relief was extended to the famine in Shuntian, Hejian, and Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou, famine relief was sent to Shuntian, Hejian, and Baoding.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，張輔擒黎季犛、黎蒼獻京師，安南平，河南饑，逮治匿災有司。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiazi, Zhang Fu captured Lê Qui Lý and Lê Cang and presented them in the capital; Annam was pacified; Henan suffered famine, and officials who concealed the disaster were arrested and punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiazi, Zhang Fu seized Lê Qui Lý and Lê Cang and brought them to the capital; Annam was pacified; in Henan famine officials who had hidden the distress were seized and punished.

sentences.zh: 敕都察院，凡災傷不以實聞者罪之。

translations.literal: An order to the Censorate said: "Whenever disaster and injury are not reported truthfully, those responsible shall be punished."
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate was charged: whoever failed to report disaster damage honestly would answer for it.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，以安南平，詔天下，置交阯布政司。

translations.literal: On guiwei, because Annam was pacified, an edict was issued to the realm, and the Jiaozhi Provincial Administration Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, with Annam subdued, an edict went throughout the empire and the Jiaozhi provincial administration commission was created.

sentences.zh: 己丑，山陽民丁玨訐其鄉人誹謗，擢為刑科給事中。

translations.literal: On jichou, a man of Shanyang named Ding Yu accused his fellow townsman of slander and was promoted to Supervising Secretary in the Bureau of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Ding Yu of Shanyang denounced a neighbor for slander and was raised to supervising secretary in the Bureau of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔自永樂二年六月後犯罪去官者，悉宥之。

translations.literal: On jiawu, an edict ordered that all who had left office for crimes after the sixth month of Yongle year 2 should be fully pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict pardoned every official dismissed for crime since the sixth month of Yongle 2.

sentences.zh: 乙未，張輔移師會韓觀討潯、柳叛蠻。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Zhang Fu moved his army to join Han Guan in attacking the rebellious Miao of Xun and Liu.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Zhang Fu marched to unite with Han Guan against the Xun and Liu rebels.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命張輔訪交阯人才，禮遣赴京師。

translations.literal: On guimao, Zhang Fu was ordered to seek out talent in Jiaozhi and send it to the capital with ritual courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Zhang Fu was commanded to recruit men of ability in Jiaozhi and escort them courteously to the capital.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，皇后崩。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yimao, the empress passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yimao, the empress died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，河溢河南。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the Yellow River overflowed in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Yellow River burst its banks in Henan.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，左都督何福鎮甘肅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yiyou, the Left Regional Commander He Fu was stationed in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou, the left regional commander He Fu took post in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 庚子，錄囚，雜犯死罪減等論戍，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: On gengzi, prisoners were reviewed; miscellaneous capital crimes were reduced one degree and sentenced to frontier service, and those below exile were released.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the court reviewed prisoners, commuting mixed capital offenses to frontier service and freeing all below exile.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，鄭和還。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renzi, Zheng He returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi, Zheng He came home from the sea.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，禦奉天門，受安南俘，大賚將士。

translations.literal: On yimao, he held court at Fengtian Gate, received the Annam captives, and bestowed great rewards on the officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he took the throne at Fengtian Gate, accepted the Annam prisoners, and lavished rewards on the army.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，潯、柳蠻平。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Xun and Liu Miao were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the Xun and Liu rebellions were put down.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、山南，婆羅，日本，別失八里，阿魯，撒馬兒罕，蘇門答剌，滿剌加，小葛蘭入貢。

translations.literal: That year the central and southern kings of Ryukyu, Borneo, Japan, Beshbalik, Aru, Samarkand, Samudera, Malacca, and Little Golan presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In that year envoys came from Ryukyu's central and southern courts, Borneo, Japan, Beshbalik, Aru, Samarkand, Samudera, Malacca, and Little Golan.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月丁巳，岷王楩復有罪，罷其官屬。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the sixth year, on the day dingsi, the Prince of Min, Zhen, again committed an offense, and his household officials were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, first month of spring, on dingsi, Prince Zhen of Min offended again and his staff were removed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，除北京永樂五年以前逋賦，免諸色課程三年。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingwei, arrears of tax levies in Beijing before Yongle year 5 were remitted, and all categories of commercial dues were exempted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingwei, Beijing tax arrears before Yongle 5 were cancelled and every commercial levy waived for three years.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，寧陽伯陳懋鎮寧夏。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guichou, the Earl of Ningyang, Chen Mao, was stationed in Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guichou, Chen Mao, Earl of Ningyang, took command in Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，除河南、山東、山西永樂五年以前逋賦。

translations.literal: On yimao, arrears of tax levies in Henan, Shandong, and Shanxi before Yongle year 5 were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao tax arrears before Yongle 5 in Henan, Shandong, and Shanxi were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，始命雲南鄉試。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on bingshen, the Yunnan provincial examination was instituted for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingshen, the provincial civil examination was inaugurated in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌夜，京師地震。

translations.literal: On the night of renxu in the fifth month, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renxu in the fifth month the capital quaked.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，詔罷北京諸司不急之務及買辦，以甦民困；

translations.literal: On gengchen, an edict ordered that non-urgent business of the Beijing offices and all procurement purchases be suspended to ease the people's hardship;
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an edict halted nonessential Beijing office work and government purchases to relieve the people's distress;

sentences.zh: 流民來歸者復三年。

translations.literal: those among the drifting people who returned were exempted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: returning vagrants were granted three years' exemption from levies.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，張輔、沐晟還。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Zhang Fu and Mu Sheng returned.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Zhang Fu and Mu Sheng came back to court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，論平交阯功，進封張輔英國公，沐晟黔國公，王友清遠侯，封都督僉事柳升安遠伯，余爵賞有差。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guichou, the merits of pacifying Jiaozhi were discussed; Zhang Fu was advanced and enfeoffed as Duke of England, Mu Sheng as Duke of Qian, Wang You as Marquis of Qingyuan; the Regional Commander Liu Sheng was enfeoffed as Earl of Anyuan; other ranks and rewards were granted according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guichou, rewards for the Jiaozhi campaign were settled: Zhang Fu became Duke of England, Mu Sheng Duke of Qian, Wang You Marquis of Qingyuan, and Liu Sheng Earl of Anyuan, with lesser honors apportioned by merit.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，交阯簡定反，沐晟為征夷將軍，討之，劉俊仍參贊軍務。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yiyou, Jian Ding rebelled in Jiaozhi; Mu Sheng was made General for the Punitive Campaign against the Barbarians to attack him, and Liu Jun again assisted in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou, Jian Ding rose in Jiaozhi; Mu Sheng was named punitive general against the barbarians, with Liu Jun again advising on the campaign.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，命刑部疏滯獄。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiyou, the Ministry of Justice was ordered to clear backlogged cases.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiyou, the Ministry of Justice was commanded to drain the backlog of suits.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，鄭和復使西洋。

translations.literal: On guihai, Zheng He was again dispatched to the Western Ocean.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zheng He sailed again for the Western Ocean.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丁巳，錄囚。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on dingsi, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on dingsi, the court held a prison review.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，沐晟及簡定戰於生厥江，敗績，劉俊及都督僉事呂毅、參政劉昱死之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingyou, Mu Sheng fought Jian Ding at the Shengjue River and was defeated; Liu Jun and the Regional Commander Lü Yi and the Administrative Commissioner Liu Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingyou, Mu Sheng met Jian Ding on the Shengjue River and was beaten; Liu Jun, Lü Yi, and Liu Yu fell in the field.

sentences.zh: 是月，柳升、陳瑄、李彬等率舟師分道沿海捕倭。

translations.literal: That month, Liu Sheng, Chen Xuan, Li Bin, and others led naval forces by separate routes along the coast to hunt Japanese pirates.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Liu Sheng, Chen Xuan, and Li Bin divided the fleet along the coast to hunt wokou.

sentences.zh: 是年，鬼力赤為其下所弒，立本雅失裏為可汗。

translations.literal: That year Guilichi was murdered by his subordinates, and Benyashili was set up as khan.
translations.idiomatic: That year Guilichi was slain by his own men and Benyashiri was raised as khan.

sentences.zh: 浡泥國王來朝。

translations.literal: The king of Brunei came to court.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Brunei attended court in person.

sentences.zh: 瓦剌，占城，於闐，暹羅，撒馬兒罕，榜葛剌，馮嘉施蘭，日本，爪哇，琉球中山、山南入貢。

translations.literal: Oirat, Champa, Khotan, Siam, Samarkand, Bengal, Fengjiashilan, Japan, Java, and the central and southern kings of Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute arrived from Oirat, Champa, Khotan, Siam, Samarkand, Bengal, Fengjiashilan, Japan, Java, and the central and southern courts of Ryukyu.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月癸丑，賜百官上元節假十日，著為令。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the seventh year, on the day guichou, the officials were granted ten days' leave for the Lantern Festival, established as a permanent regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, first month of spring, on guichou, officials received ten days' leave for the Lantern Festival, fixed hereafter as statute.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On yimao, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，遣使於巡狩所經郡縣存問高年，八十以上賜酒肉，九十加帛。

translations.literal: On yihai, envoys were sent to the prefectures and counties along the imperial tour route to inquire after the aged; those over eighty were given wine and meat, and those over ninety received cloth in addition.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai envoys visited every district on the northern tour to comfort the elderly; men of eighty received wine and meat, men of ninety cloth as well.

sentences.zh: 丙子，徵致仕知府劉彥才等九十二人分署府州縣。

translations.literal: On bingzi, ninety-two retired prefects including Liu Yancai were summoned and assigned to administer prefectures, departments, and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi ninety-two retired prefects, Liu Yancai among them, were recalled to fill posts in the prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以北巡告天地宗廟社稷。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the northern tour was announced at the temples of Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the impending northern tour was reported to Heaven, Earth, the imperial ancestors, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 壬午，發京師，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On renwu, he departed the capital; the crown prince supervised the state.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he left the capital while the crown prince governed in his stead.

sentences.zh: 張輔、王友率師討簡定。

translations.literal: Zhang Fu and Wang You led armies to attack Jian Ding.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fu and Wang You took the field against Jian Ding.

sentences.zh: 戊子，謁鳳陽皇陵。

translations.literal: On wuzi, he visited the imperial mausoleum at Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he paid homage at the Fengyang imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，次東平州，望祭泰山。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiachen, he halted at Dongping Prefecture and performed a distance-sacrifice to Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiachen, he paused at Dongping and offered a distant rite to Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，次景州，望祭恒山。

translations.literal: On xinhai, he halted at Jing Prefecture and performed a distance-sacrifice to Mount Heng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he stopped at Jingzhou and offered a distant rite to Mount Heng.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，平安自殺。

translations.literal: On yimao, Ping An committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Ping An took his own life.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，至北京。

translations.literal: On renxu, he reached Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he entered Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，大賚官吏軍民。

translations.literal: On guihai, officials, soldiers, and civilians were richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai officials, troops, and townsfolk received lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔起兵時將士及北京效力人民雜犯死罪鹹宥之，充軍者官復職，軍民還籍伍。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict ordered that soldiers of the founding armies and the people who had served Beijing, guilty of miscellaneous capital crimes, should all be pardoned; those sentenced to military exile should have their offices restored, and soldiers and civilians returned to their original registers and companies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict pardoned founding veterans and Beijing workers condemned for mixed capital offenses, restored office to exiles serving in the ranks, and sent soldiers and civilians back to their original rolls.

sentences.zh: 壬申，柳升敗倭於青州海中，敕還師。

translations.literal: On renshen, Liu Sheng defeated Japanese pirates in the sea off Qingzhou and was ordered to withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Liu Sheng routed wokou off Qingzhou and was commanded to bring the fleet home.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉朔，皇太子攝享太廟。

translations.literal: On the first day guiwei of the fourth month of summer, the crown prince performed a proxy sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the new moon of the fourth month of summer, the crown prince offered the seasonal sacrifice at the Grand Temple by proxy.

sentences.zh: 壬午，海寇犯欽州，副總兵李珪遣將擊敗之。

translations.literal: On renwu, sea bandits attacked Qinzhou; the Vice Commander-in-Chief Li Gui sent generals who defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu sea raiders struck Qinzhou; Vice Commander Li Gui dispatched generals who drove them off.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊申，命皇太子所決庶務，六科月一類奏。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on wushen, it was ordered that routine business decided by the crown prince should be classified and memorialized once a month by the Six Offices of Scrutiny.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wushen, the six scrutiny offices were commanded to file monthly summaries of civil business the crown prince had decided.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，諭行在法司，重罪必五覆奏。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the traveling court's judicial offices were instructed: for grave offenses there must be fivefold memorial review.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the Emperor instructed the judicial offices at the traveling court that capital cases required five separate memorial reviews before execution.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，營山陵於昌平，封其山曰天壽。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the fifth month, imperial tombs were constructed at Changping; that mountain was enfeoffed with the title Tianshou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, work began on the imperial mausoleum at Changping, and the hill there was named Tianshou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，封瓦剌馬哈木為順寧王，太平為賢義王，把禿孛羅為安樂王。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Mahamu of the Oirats was enfeoffed as Prince of Shunning and Tranquility, Taiping as Prince of Worthy Righteousness, and Batu Boluo as Prince of Peace and Joy.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the Oirat leaders Mahamu, Taiping, and Batu Boluo were enfeoffed as Princes of Shunning Tranquility, Worthy Righteousness, and Peaceful Joy respectively.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，察北巡郡縣長吏，擢汶上知縣史誠祖治行第一，下易州同知張騰於獄。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the sixth month, while inspecting the north the Emperor examined prefectural and county chiefs; Shi Chengzu, magistrate of Wenshang, was promoted for ranking first in governance, and Zhang Teng, vice prefect of Yizhou, was cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renyin, during the northern inspection the Emperor reviewed local administrators, promoted Wenshang magistrate Shi Chengzu for the best record of rule, and imprisoned Yizhou vice prefect Zhang Teng.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，給事中郭驥使本雅失裏，為所殺。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Supervising Secretary Guo Ji was sent as envoy to Benyashiri and was killed by him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the supervising secretary Guo Ji went on embassy to Benyashiri and was slain there.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，斥御史洪秉等四人，詔自今御史勿用吏員。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Censor Hong Bing and three others were dismissed; an edict declared that henceforth censors should not be drawn from clerical ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao four censors including Hong Bing were expelled, and an edict forbade appointing former clerks to the censorate.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，淇國公丘福為征虜大將軍，武成侯王聰、同安侯火真副之，靖安侯王忠、安平侯李遠為左、右參將，討本雅失裏。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the seventh month of autumn, Duke of Qi Guo Qiu Fu was made Grand General for the Punitive Expedition against the Barbarians, with Marquis of Wucheng Wang Cong and Marquis of Tong'an Huo Zhen as deputies and Marquis of Jing'an Wang Zhong and Marquis of Ping'an Li Yuan as left and right assistant commanders, to campaign against Benyashiri.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiyou, Qiu Fu, Duke of Qi, was named grand general for the punitive expedition, with Wang Cong and Huo Zhen as lieutenant generals and Wang Zhong and Li Yuan as wing commanders, to strike Benyashiri.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，丘福敗績於臚朐河，福及聰、真、忠、遠皆戰死。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the eighth month, Qiu Fu suffered defeat at the Luchuan River; Fu, Cong, Zhen, Zhong, and Yuan all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiayin, Qiu Fu was routed on the Luchuan River; he, Wang Cong, Huo Zhen, Wang Zhong, and Li Yuan all fell in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 庚申，張輔敗賊於鹹子關。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Zhang Fu defeated the rebels at Xianzi Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Zhang Fu routed the enemy at Xianzi Pass.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day gengwu of the ninth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the new moon of the ninth month, gengwu, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 張輔敗賊於太平海口。

translations.literal: Zhang Fu defeated the rebels at Taiping Estuary.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fu again routed the rebels at Taiping Estuary.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，贈北征死事李遠莒國公、王聰漳國公，遂決意親征。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Li Yuan, who had died on the northern campaign, was posthumously ennobled Duke of Ju State, and Wang Cong Duke of Zhang State; the Emperor then resolved to lead the expedition in person.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Yuan and Wang Cong, who had died on the northern campaign, were posthumously created dukes of Ju and Zhang; the Emperor then determined to take the field himself.

sentences.zh: 丙子，武安侯鄭亨率師巡邊。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Marquis of Wu'an Zheng Heng led troops to patrol the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Marquis of Wu'an, Zheng Heng, led a column to patrol the border.

sentences.zh: 壬午，成安候郭亮備禦開平。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Marquis of Cheng'an Guo Liang made preparations to defend Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Marquis of Cheng'an, Guo Liang, took post to guard Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，削丘福封爵，徙其家於海南。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei in the tenth month of winter, Qiu Fu's enfeoffment was struck off and his family was banished to Hainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingwei, Qiu Fu's title was revoked and his household was exiled to Hainan.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，張輔獲簡定於美良，送京師，誅之。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the eleventh month, Zhang Fu captured Jian Ding at Meiliang, sent him to the capital, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuyin, Zhang Fu seized Jian Ding at Meiliang, sent him to the capital, and put him to death.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，賜濟寧至良鄉民頻年遞運者田租一年。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu in the twelfth month, the people between Jining and Liangxiang who for years had performed relay transport were granted remission of land tax for one year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengxu, peasants along the Jining–Liangxiang transport corridor who had borne relay duty year after year were granted one year's remission of field tax.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，召張輔還。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Zhang Fu was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhang Fu was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 是年，滿剌加，哈烈，撒馬兒罕，火州，古裏，占城，蘇門答剌，琉球中山、山南入貢。

translations.literal: That year Malacca, Herat, Samarkand, Huozhou, Calicut, Champa, Samudra, and Ryukyu's Zhongshan and Shannan presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute arrived from Malacca, Herat, Samarkand, Huozhou, Calicut, Champa, Samudra, and from both Zhongshan and Shannan in Ryukyu.

sentences.zh: 暹羅、榜葛剌入貢者再。

translations.literal: Siam and Bengal each sent tribute twice.
translations.idiomatic: Siam and Bengal each presented tribute on two occasions.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月辛未，召寧陽侯陳懋隨征漠北。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the eighth year, on the day xinwei, Marquis of Ningyang Chen Mao was summoned to accompany the campaign into the northern deserts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, first month of spring, on xinwei, the Marquis of Ningyang, Chen Mao, was called up to join the desert campaign.

sentences.zh: 己卯，皇太子攝祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the Crown Prince officiated at the southern suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Crown Prince performed the suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，免去年揚州、淮安、鳳陽、陳州水災田租，贖軍民所鬻子女。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, land tax from last year's flood in Yangzhou, Huai'an, Fengyang, and Chenzhou was remitted, and children sold by soldiers and civilians were redeemed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi last year's flood taxes in Yangzhou, Huai'an, Fengyang, and Chenzhou were forgiven, and children sold by soldiers and commoners were bought back.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，以北征詔天下，命戶部尚書夏原吉輔皇長孫瞻基留守北京。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the second month, the northern expedition was proclaimed throughout the realm; Minister of Revenue Xia Yuanji was ordered to assist the eldest imperial grandson Zhanji in holding Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinchou, the northern campaign was announced to the empire, and Minister of Revenue Xia Yuanji was left in Beijing to assist the eldest imperial grandson, Zhanji.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，皇太子錄囚，奏貰雜犯死罪以下，從之。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Crown Prince reviewed prisoners and memorialized pardon for miscellaneous offenses below capital crimes; the Emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Crown Prince reviewed prisoners and recommended pardons for non-capital miscellaneous crimes; the Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 丁未，發北京。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the Emperor set out from Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the Emperor marched out from Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遣祭所過名山大川。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, sacrifices were dispatched to famous mountains and great rivers along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai envoys were sent to offer sacrifice at famous mountains and rivers along the line of march.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大閱。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, a grand military review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the army was reviewed in full.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，清遠侯王友督中軍，安遠伯柳升副之，寧遠侯何福、武安侯鄭亨督左、右哨，寧陽侯陳懋、廣恩伯劉才督左、右掖，都督劉江督前哨。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the third month, Marquis of Qingyuan Wang You commanded the central army with Earl of Anyuan Liu Sheng as deputy; Marquis of Ningyuan He Fu and Marquis of Wu'an Zheng Heng commanded the left and right flanking guards; Marquis of Ningyang Chen Mao and Baron of Guang'en Liu Cai commanded the left and right support wings; Commissioner-in-chief Liu Jiang commanded the vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingmao, Wang You, Marquis of Qingyuan, took the center with Liu Sheng, Earl of Anyuan, as his second; He Fu and Zheng Heng led the left and right screens, Chen Mao and Liu Cai the left and right wings, and Liu Jiang the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，次鳴鑾戍。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the army halted at Mingluan Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the host encamped at Mingluan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，誓師。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the troops were sworn to the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the army swore the campaign oath.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，次威虜鎮，以橐季駝所載水給衛士，視軍士皆食，始進膳。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the fourth month of summer, the army halted at Weilu Fort; water carried on camel loads was given to the guards; only when he saw all the soldiers had eaten did the Emperor take his meal.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen, the army stopped at Weilu; camel-borne water was issued to the guards, and the Emperor would not dine until every soldier had been fed.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，更名臚朐河曰飲馬。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the fifth month, the Luchuan River was renamed Yinma.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingmao, the Luchuan River was renamed the Drinking Horse River.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，聞本雅失裏西奔，遂渡飲馬河追之。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, hearing that Benyashiri had fled west, the Emperor crossed the Yinma River in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, learning that Benyashiri had bolted westward, the Emperor crossed the Drinking Horse River in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 己卯，及於斡難河，大敗之，本雅失裏以七騎遁。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, he overtook him at the Onon River and inflicted a great defeat; Benyashiri escaped with seven horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he caught the enemy on the Onon and routed them utterly; Benyashiri fled with only seven riders.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，還次飲馬河，詔移師征阿魯臺。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, returning to camp at the Yinma River, an edict ordered the army shifted to campaign against Aruqtai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, back at the Drinking Horse River, an edict turned the army against Aruqtai.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，回回哈剌馬牙殺都指揮劉秉謙，據肅州衛以叛，千戶硃迪等討平之。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Muslim Halaima killed Regional Commander Liu Bingqian, seized Suzhou Guard in rebellion, and was suppressed by Qianhu Zhu Di and others.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Muslim Halaima murdered Regional Commander Liu Bingqian, seized Suzhou Guard in revolt, and was put down by the thousand-householder Zhu Di and his fellows.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，阿魯臺偽降，命諸將嚴陣以待，果悉眾來犯。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen in the sixth month, Aruqtai feigned surrender; the Emperor ordered the generals to hold formation in readiness, and indeed the enemy came in full force to attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiachen, Aruqtai pretended to submit; the Emperor told his generals to stand battle-ready, and the foe duly came in full strength.

sentences.zh: 帝自將精騎迎擊。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally led elite cavalry to meet the attack.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor himself led picked horsemen to meet them.

sentences.zh: 大敗之，追北百余裏。

translations.literal: He inflicted a great defeat and pursued north for more than a hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: He shattered them and chased north for over a hundred li.

sentences.zh: 丁未，又敗之。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, he defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he beat them again.

sentences.zh: 己酉，班師。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the army turned homeward.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，次開平。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the seventh month of autumn, the army halted at Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingmao, the host encamped at Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 帝在軍，念士卒艱苦，每蔬食，是日宴賚，始復常膳。

translations.literal: While in the army the Emperor thought on the soldiers' hardships and ate only vegetables; on that day, at the banquet reward, he resumed his regular fare.
translations.idiomatic: On campaign the Emperor, mindful of the troops' hardship, ate plain fare; only at that day's feast of reward did he return to his usual table.

sentences.zh: 西寧侯宋琥鎮甘肅。

translations.literal: Marquis of Xining Song Huo was stationed in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Song Huo, Marquis of Xining, took command in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，振安慶、徽州、鳳陽、鎮江饑。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, relief was extended to famine in Anqing, Huizhou, Fengyang, and Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi famine relief was sent to Anqing, Huizhou, Fengyang, and Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至北京，禦奉天殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the Emperor reached Beijing, took the throne at Fengtian Hall, and received court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Emperor entered Beijing, ascended Fengtian Hall, and received the court's congratulations.

sentences.zh: 甲午，論功行賞有差。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, merit was assessed and rewards distributed according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu rewards were apportioned by merit.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，進封柳升安遠侯。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the eighth month, Liu Sheng was advanced to Marquis of Anyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renyin, Liu Sheng was promoted to Marquis of Anyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，何福自殺。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, He Fu committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao He Fu took his own life.

sentences.zh: 庚申，河溢開封。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the Yellow River overflowed at Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，幸天壽山。

translations.literal: On the day jisi in the ninth month, the Emperor visited Tianshou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jisi, the Emperor went to Tianshou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，發北京。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the tenth month of winter, the Emperor set out from Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingyou, the Emperor left Beijing again.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭寇福州。

translations.literal: That month, Japanese pirates raided Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That same month wokou struck Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，至京師。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the eleventh month, he reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiaxu, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，阿魯臺遣使貢馬。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the twelfth month, Aruqtai sent envoys presenting horses in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guisi, Aruqtai sent envoys offering horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊午，陳季擴乞降，以為交阯右布政使，季擴不受命。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Chen Jikuo begged to surrender and was appointed Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Jiaozhi; Jikuo did not accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Chen Jikuo sued for peace and was named right administration commissioner of Jiaozhi, but he refused the post.

sentences.zh: 是年，失捏幹寇黃河東岸，寧夏都指揮王亻叔敗沒。

translations.literal: That year the Shiningan raided the east bank of the Yellow River; Wang Bi, regional commander of Ningxia, was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Shiningan harried the east bank of the Yellow River, and Wang Bi, Ningxia's regional commander, was defeated and lost his life.

sentences.zh: 浡泥、呂宋、馮嘉施蘭、蘇門答剌、榜葛剌入貢。

translations.literal: Brunei, Luzon, Pangasinan, Samudra, and Bengal presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute came from Brunei, Luzon, Pangasinan, Samudra, and Bengal.

sentences.zh: 占城貢象。

translations.literal: Champa presented elephants in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Champa sent elephants as tribute.

sentences.zh: 琉球山南、爪哇、暹羅貢馬。

translations.literal: Ryukyu Shannan, Java, and Siam presented horses in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu Shannan, Java, and Siam each presented horses.

sentences.zh: 琉球中山入貢者三。

translations.literal: Ryukyu Zhongshan presented tribute three times.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu Zhongshan sent tribute on three occasions.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月甲戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the ninth year, on the day jiaxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, first month of spring, on jiaxu, the Emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 丙子，柳升鎮寧夏。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Liu Sheng was stationed at Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Liu Sheng took command at Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 巳卯，張輔為征虜副將軍，會沐晟討交阯。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Zhang Fu was made deputy grand general for the punitive expedition against the barbarians and joined Mu Sheng to campaign in Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Zhang Fu was named deputy grand general for the punitive expedition and joined Mu Sheng against Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，豐城侯李彬、平江伯陳瑄率浙江、福建兵捕海寇。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Marquis of Fengcheng Li Bin and Earl of Pingjiang Chen Xuan led troops from Zhejiang and Fujian to capture sea pirates.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Bin, Marquis of Fengcheng, and Chen Xuan, Earl of Pingjiang, led Zhejiang and Fujian forces against sea raiders.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，陳瑛有罪，下獄死。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the second month, Chen Ying was found guilty, imprisoned, and died in custody.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinhai, Chen Ying was judged guilty, thrown into prison, and died there.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔赦交阯。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict proclaimed amnesty for Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict granted amnesty throughout Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，倭陷昌化千戶所。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Japanese raiders took the Qianhu Office of Changhua.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Japanese pirates overran the Changhua garrison.

sentences.zh: 己未，工部尚書宋禮開會通河。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Minister of Works Song Li opened the Huitong Canal.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Minister of Works Song Li cut the Huitong Canal.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，賜蕭時中等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the third month, Xiao Shi and others who passed the palace examination and those receiving other degrees were granted rewards according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiazi, palace graduates led by Xiao Shi and those receiving lower degrees were rewarded by rank.

sentences.zh: 壬午，浚祥符縣黃河故道。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the old course of the Yellow River in Xiangfu County was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the old Yellow River channel in Xiangfu was cleared.

sentences.zh: 戊子，劉江鎮遼東。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Liu Jiang was stationed in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Liu Jiang took command in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 夏六月乙巳，鄭和還自西洋。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the sixth month of summer, Zheng He returned from the Western Ocean.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on yisi, Zheng He returned from the Western Ocean.

sentences.zh: 是月，下交阯右參議解縉於獄。

translations.literal: That month, Jie Jin, Right Participating Secretary of Jiaozhi, was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jie Jin, right participating secretary of Jiaozhi, was cast into prison.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，張輔敗賊於月常江。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi in the seventh month of autumn, Zhang Fu defeated the rebels on the Yuechang River.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingzi, Zhang Fu routed the rebels on the Yuechang River.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，諭法司，凡死罪必五覆奏。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the ninth month, the judicial offices were instructed that all capital crimes must receive fivefold memorial review.
