translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuyin, the judiciary was told that every capital case required five memorial reviews.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命屯田軍以公事妨農務者，免徵子粒，著為令。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, it was ordered that garrison farm troops whose official duties interfered with farming were exempted from grain tax, and this was established as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu troops on garrison farms whose public duties cut into the season were exempted from grain levies, and the rule was written into law.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，寬北京謫徙軍民賦役。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the tenth month of winter, tax and corvée burdens were eased for military and civilian exiles in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yiwei, levies on exiled soldiers and civilians in Beijing were lightened.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，封哈密兔力帖木兒為忠義王。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Tieliemuer of Hami was enfeoffed as Prince of Loyal Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Hami ruler Tieliemuer was created Prince of Loyal Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復修《太祖實錄》。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Veritable Records of the Ancestor were again revised.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi work resumed on the Veritable Records of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，蠲陜西逋賦。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu in the eleventh month, overdue taxes in Shaanxi were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuwu, Shaanxi's arrears in tax were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，張輔敗賊於生厥江。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Zhang Fu defeated the rebels on the Shengque River.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhang Fu routed the enemy on the Shengque River.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，立皇長孫瞻基為皇太孫。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the eldest imperial grandson Zhanji was established as Imperial Grandson Heir.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the eldest imperial grandson, Zhanji, was named heir to the imperial grandson.

sentences.zh: 壬申，韓觀為征夷副將軍，改鎮交阯，都指揮葛森鎮廣西。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Han Guan was appointed Deputy Grand General for the Punitive Expedition against the Yi, transferred to garrison Jiaozhi, and Regional Commander Ge Sen garrisoned Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Han Guan became deputy grand general for the punitive expedition against the Yi and was reassigned to Jiaozhi, while Ge Sen took command in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 丙子，敕法司決遣罪囚毋淹滯。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the judicial offices were ordered to decide and dispatch criminal prisoners without delay.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the judiciary was commanded to dispose of prisoners without lingering delay.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣使督瘞戰場暴骨。

translations.literal: That month, envoys were sent to oversee burial of exposed bones on battlefields.
translations.idiomatic: That month commissioners were dispatched to gather and bury the unburied dead on the battlefields.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，敕宥福余、朵顏、泰寧三衛罪，令入貢。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the twelfth month, an edict pardoned the offenses of the three guards of Fuyu, Tümed, and Teleng and ordered them to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renchen, an edict pardoned the Fuyu, Tümed, and Teleng guards and summoned them back to tribute.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁巳，命府部諸臣陳軍民利弊。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the intercalary month, ministers of the ministries and commissions were ordered to set forth benefits and harms for soldiers and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingsi, ministers of the ministries were told to report what helped or hurt soldiers and the people.

sentences.zh: 是年，浙江、湖廣、湖南、順天、揚州水，河南、陜西疫，遣使振之。

translations.literal: That year Zhejiang, Huguang, Hunan, Shuntian, and Yangzhou suffered flooding; Henan and Shaanxi suffered pestilence; envoys were sent to give relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods struck Zhejiang, Huguang, Hunan, Shuntian, and Yangzhou, while plague ravaged Henan and Shaanxi; relief envoys were sent out.

sentences.zh: 滿剌加王來朝。

translations.literal: The king of Malacca came to court.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Malacca came in person to court.

sentences.zh: 爪哇、榜葛剌、古裏、柯枝、蘇門答剌、阿魯、彭亨、急蘭丹、南巫裏、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Java, Bengal, Calicut, Cochin, Samudra, Aru, Pahang, Kelantan, Lamuri, and Siam presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute arrived from Java, Bengal, Calicut, Cochin, Samudra, Aru, Pahang, Kelantan, Lamuri, and Siam.

sentences.zh: 阿魯臺來貢馬，別失八里獻文豹。

translations.literal: Aruqtai came presenting horses in tribute; Beshbalik presented a patterned leopard.
translations.idiomatic: Aruqtai sent horses in tribute, and Beshbalik offered a leopard.

sentences.zh: 琉球中山入貢者三。

translations.literal: Ryukyu Zhongshan presented tribute three times.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu Zhongshan sent tribute on three occasions.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月己丑，命入覲官千五百余人各陳民瘼，不言者罪之，言有不當勿問。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on the day jichou, more than fifteen hundred officials attending court were ordered each to state the people's grievances; those who did not speak were punished; improper speech was not held against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, first month of spring, on jichou, over fifteen hundred officials summoned to court were told to voice the people's ills on pain of punishment for silence, with no penalty for awkward speech.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the Emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，振平陽饑，逮治布政使及郡縣官不奏聞者。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, famine in Pingyang was relieved; provincial administration commissioners and prefectural and county officials who had not reported were arrested and punished.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou famine relief went to Pingyang, and provincial and local officials who had failed to report were seized and punished.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，蠲山西、河南逋賦。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the second month, overdue taxes in Shanxi and Henan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinyou, tax arrears in Shanxi and Henan were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，遼王植有罪，削其護衛。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Prince of Liao Zhu Zhi was guilty; his guard troops were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Prince of Liao, Zhu Zhi, was found guilty and his guard establishment was cut back.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，豐城侯李彬討甘肅叛寇八耳思朵羅歹。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the third month, Marquis of Fengcheng Li Bin campaigned against the Gansu rebel Ba'ersiduo Luodai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dinghai, Li Bin, Marquis of Fengcheng, marched against the Gansu rebel Ba'ersiduo Luodai.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賜馬鐸等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Ma Duo and others were granted the jinshi degree and chushen titles with graded distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the throne conferred advanced and initial degrees on Ma Duo and the other graduates, with ranks apportioned by standing.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，免北京水災租稅。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, rents and taxes from Beijing's flood disaster were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, flood-stricken Beijing was granted remission of land tax and levies.

sentences.zh: 夏六月甲戌，諭戶部，凡郡縣有司及朝使目擊民艱不言者，悉逮治。

translations.literal: In summer, the sixth month, on the day jiaxu, the Ministry of Revenue was instructed: any prefecture or county official, or any court envoy, who had seen the people's hardships with his own eyes yet said nothing—let all be seized and punished.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on jiaxu of the sixth month, the throne ordered the Ministry of Revenue to arrest and try every local magistrate or imperial inspector who had witnessed popular distress and reported nothing.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯，禁中官干預有司政事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day guimao, eunuchs were forbidden to interfere in the administrative affairs of the regular offices.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on guimao of the seventh month, the court barred palace eunuchs from meddling in the business of the civil administration.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，張輔大破交阯賊於神投海。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guichou, Zhang Fu inflicted a great defeat on the Jiaozhi rebels at the Sea of Divine Casting.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guichou, Zhang Fu routed the rebel forces of Jiaozhi at Shentou Sea.

sentences.zh: 己未，敕邊將自長安嶺迤西迄洗馬林築石垣，深濠塹。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, frontier commanders were commanded, from Chang'an Ridge westward as far as Xima Lin, to build stone ramparts with deep moats and ditches.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, border generals were ordered to erect stone walls and dig deep trenches along the line from Chang'an Ridge west to Xima Lin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，獵城南武岡。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day wuchen, he hunted at Wugang south of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on wuchen of the tenth month, the emperor hunted at Wugang, south of the city.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，侍講楊榮經略甘肅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renwu, the Lecturer-in-waiting Yang Rong was assigned to oversee Gansu affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renwu, Lecturer Yang Rong was sent to take charge of affairs in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 丙申，鄭和復使西洋。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Zheng He was again dispatched on a mission to the Western Ocean.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Zheng He set sail again for the Western Seas.

sentences.zh: 是年，浡泥、占城、暹羅、滿剌加、榜葛剌、蘇門答剌、南浡利、球琉山南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Poni, Champa, Siam, Malacca, Bengal, Samudera, South Poni, and Ryukyu Shannan presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: During the year, envoys came with tribute from Poni, Champa, Siam, Malacca, Bengal, Samudera, South Poni, and Shan-nan in the Ryukyus.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月辛己朔，日有食之，詔罷朝賀宴會。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, spring, on the first day of the first month, the day xinsi, there was a solar eclipse; an edict suspended court congratulations and feasts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, at the new moon of the first month on xinsi, a solar eclipse occurred; the court called off the New Year audience and banquets.

sentences.zh: 壬午，諭通政使、禮科給事中，凡朝覲官境內災傷不能聞為他人所奏者，罪之。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the Commissioner of Transmission and the supervising secretary of the Bureau of Rites were instructed: any official coming to court who, within his jurisdiction, failed to report disaster damage until another reported it—let him be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Commissioner of Transmission and the supervising secretary of the Bureau of Rites were told to punish any official at court audience who had left disaster in his jurisdiction unreported until someone else brought it up.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Heaven and Earth were worshipped with the great sacrifice at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，豐城侯李彬鎮甘肅，召宋琥還。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the Marquis of Fengcheng, Li Bin, was stationed to guard Gansu; Song Hu was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Marquis Li Bin of Fengcheng was posted to command Gansu, and Song Hu was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，始設貴州布政司。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinhai, the Guizhou Provincial Administration Commission was first established.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinhai, the court created the Guizhou provincial administration.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，令北京民戶分養孳生馬，著為令。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, households in Beijing were ordered to share in raising breeding horses; this was issued as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Beijing households were required to share in breeding stud horses, and the rule was written into law.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸北京，皇太孫從。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, he proceeded to Beijing; the Imperial Heir Apparent accompanied him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the emperor went to Beijing, with the imperial grandson in his train.

sentences.zh: 尚書蹇義、學士黃淮、諭德楊士奇、洗馬楊溥輔皇太子監國。

translations.literal: The Ministers Jian Yi and Huang Huai, the Preceptor Yang Shiqi, and the Study Aide Yang Pu assisted the Crown Prince in overseeing the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Jian Yi, Academician Huang Huai, Preceptor Yang Shiqi, and Study Aide Yang Pu remained to assist the Crown Prince in governing during the emperor's absence.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，發京師，命給事中、御史所過存間高年，賜酒肉及帛。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, he set out from the capital and ordered supervising secretaries and censors along the route to visit and console the aged, bestowing wine, meat, and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, he left the capital and charged the supervising secretaries and touring censors to call on the elderly along the way and give them wine, meat, and cloth.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，葬仁孝皇后於長陵。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the Renxiao Empress was buried at Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the Renxiao Empress was interred at Changling.

sentences.zh: 辛未，次鳳陽，謁皇陵。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, he halted at Fengyang and paid homage at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, he paused at Fengyang to worship at the dynastic tombs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，至北京。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jiyou, he arrived at Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on jiyou of the fourth month, he reached Beijing.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，曹縣獻騶虞，禮官請賀，不許。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingwei, Caoxian presented a zouyu; the ritual officials requested congratulations, but this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingwei, Caoxian sent up a zouyu; the Board of Rites asked to celebrate the omen, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，封阿魯臺為和寧王。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day wuyin, Aruqtai was enfeoffed as Prince of Hening.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on wuyin of the seventh month, Aruqtai was made Prince of Hening.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，北京地震。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiazi, there was an earthquake in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiazi, Beijing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，鎮遠侯顧成討思州、靖州叛苗。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the Marquis of Zhenyuan, Gu Cheng, campaigned against rebel Miao in Sizhou and Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Marquis Gu Cheng of Zhenyuan was sent to suppress the rebellious Miao of Sizhou and Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，詔自今郡縣官每歲春行視境內，蝗蝻害稼即捕絕之，不如詔者二司並罪。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renwu, an edict declared: from this time forward, each year in spring county and prefecture officials are to tour their jurisdictions; wherever locust nymphs harm the crops, they are immediately to be caught and wiped out. Those who do not follow the edict—the two provincial commissions shall likewise be punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renwu, an edict required magistrates to make a spring tour of their districts hereafter and exterminate locust broods wherever they threatened the crop; provincial and regional commissioners who failed to enforce the order would share the punishment.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，以璽書命皇太子錄囚。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day bingyin, by sealed imperial writ the Crown Prince was ordered to review criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on bingyin of the tenth month, the Crown Prince was charged by sealed edict to review capital cases.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，以野蠶繭為衾，命皇太子薦太廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day wuyin, quilts of wild silkworm cocoons were made, and the Crown Prince was ordered to offer them at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuyin, bedding was prepared from wild-silkworm cocoons and the Crown Prince was told to present the offering at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬午，瓦剌馬哈木兵渡飲馬河，阿魯臺告警，命邊將嚴守備。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Mahama's Oirat forces crossed the Yinma River; Aruqtai reported an alarm, and frontier commanders were ordered to tighten their defenses strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Mahama's Oirat horsemen crossed the Yinma River; Aruqtai sent word of danger, and border commanders were ordered to stand on full alert.

sentences.zh: 甲申，寧陽侯陳懋，都督譚青、馬聚、硃崇巡寧夏、大同、山西邊，簡練士馬。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the Marquis of Ningyang, Chen Mao, and the regional commanders Tan Qing, Ma Ju, and Zhu Chong patrolled the borders of Ningxia, Datong, and Shanxi, drilling troops and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Marquis Chen Mao of Ningyang and the regional commanders Tan Qing, Ma Ju, and Zhu Chong inspected the Ningxia, Datong, and Shanxi frontiers and put the men and mounts through drill.

sentences.zh: 尋命陜西、山西及潼關等五衛兵駐宣府，中都、遼東、河南三都指揮使司及武平等四衛兵會北京。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, troops from Shaanxi, Shanxi, and the five guards including Tongguan were ordered garrisoned at Xuanfu; the three regional commands of Zhongdu, Liaodong, and Henan, together with the four guards including Wuping, were ordered to concentrate at Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, garrisons from Shaanxi, Shanxi, and the five guards at Tongguan and elsewhere were posted to Xuanfu, while the three regional commands of Zhongdu, Liaodong, and Henan and the four guards of Wuping and the like were summoned to assemble at Beijing.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，應城伯孫巖備開平。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Earl of Yingcheng, Sun Yan, prepared the defenses of Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Earl Sun Yan of Yingcheng was stationed to guard Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，張輔、沐晟大敗交阯賊於愛子江。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day renzi, Zhang Fu and Mu Sheng inflicted a great defeat on the Jiaozhi rebels at the River of Beloved Son.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renzi, Zhang Fu and Mu Sheng crushed the rebel forces of Jiaozhi on the Aizi River.

sentences.zh: 是年，馬哈木弒其主本雅失裏，立答裏巴為可汗。

translations.literal: That year, Mahama murdered his lord Benyashiri and installed Daliba as Great Khan.
translations.idiomatic: During the year, Mahama killed his sovereign Benyashiri and set up Daliba as khan.

sentences.zh: 別失八里、滿剌加、占城、爪哇西王入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Bie-shi-ba-li, Malacca, Champa, and the western king of Java presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys came with tribute from Bie-shi-ba-li, Malacca, Champa, and the western king of Java.

sentences.zh: 琉球中山入貢者四。

translations.literal: Tribute missions from Ryukyu Zhongshan came four times.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu's Zhongshan domain sent tribute four times.

sentences.zh: 琉球山南入貢者再。

translations.literal: Tribute missions from Ryukyu Shannan came twice.
translations.idiomatic: Shan-nan in the Ryukyus sent tribute twice.
